items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: And Lionel Jospin runs the country.

ctx.x: So you’d be a believer in what we call alternative medicine?

Alternative medicine is the tip of the iceberg. Every doctor of any consequence would be a dietician. Because that’s the root of all sickness. The wrong foods that we put into our bodies. They make us sick. And it’s ridiculous to talk of keeping people healthy while you’re selling them the very food that’s making them sick. That’s cold. Medicine has got to change, and I think it will in this new millennium. I think a new millennium is a cosmic changing. It wipes out the old and starts a new structure. I think…
Okay, we have it on tape now.
